name: Britney
source: Britney is the captain of the cheerleading squad and daughter of the school principal. Her mother is not particularly happy that Britney has decided to devote herself to cheerleading, so she does not give her any breaks. Britney hides her feelings behind a veil of arrogance and closeness. Cold girl. She only talks to her teammates.
